evals.name: slash-command-wordcount
evals.prompt: Write a SillyTavern extension called "Word Count" that adds a /wordcount slash command. It returns the total word count of the last N chat messages (named argument, default 10) and can be piped into other commands. Add a setting in the Extensions panel to exclude system messages. Give me the complete extension folder ready to drop into SillyTavern.
evals.expected_output: Installable third-party extension folder: manifest.json with the fields ST reads, index.js that registers the command via SlashCommandParser/SlashCommand.fromProps with a typed named argument and returns a string, settings initialised with defaults and saved via saveSettingsDebounced, getContext() for chat access.
assertions: manifest.json is valid JSON with display_name, js and version
No static imports from SillyTavern internal files (uses SillyTavern.getContext() / SillyTavern.libs)
LIVE: loads in SillyTavern 1.19.0 with no extension errors in the console or Manage Extensions
Registers the command with SlashCommandParser.addCommandObject(SlashCommand.fromProps(...))
Applies the default of 10 inside the callback (does not rely on defaultValue, which ST never applies)
Settings use defaults merged per key and are saved with saveSettingsDebounced
LIVE: /wordcount with no arguments returns the correct total for the last messages of a known chat
LIVE: the result can be piped (/wordcount | /echo shows the number)
LIVE: toggling the exclude-system setting changes the count when a system message is present

evals.name: background-mood-tagger
evals.prompt: I want a SillyTavern extension that, after every AI reply, quietly asks the LLM to classify the reply's mood as one word, saves that mood on the message itself so it survives reloads, and injects "Current mood: <mood>" into the prompt at depth 2 for the next generation. It must not break when I switch chats while it's working. Build the whole thing.
evals.expected_output: Extension listening to the right event, making a quiet/raw generation, storing the result in message.extra and saving the chat, injecting via setExtensionPrompt with the right type/depth, guarding against chat switches (chat id check), and not re-triggering on its own generation.
assertions: manifest.json is valid JSON with display_name, js and version
No static imports from SillyTavern internal files (uses SillyTavern.getContext() / SillyTavern.libs)
LIVE: loads in SillyTavern 1.19.0 with no extension errors in the console or Manage Extensions
Classifies with generateRaw or generateQuietPrompt (a background call, no visible message)
Stores the mood in the message's extra field and saves the chat
Injects with setExtensionPrompt at the in-chat position (1) and depth 2, with arguments in the real order (key, value, position, depth, scan, role)
Re-applies or recomputes the injection after a chat change (CHAT_CHANGED), since ST clears extension prompts on chat load
After the await, verifies the chat is still the same before writing (chat-switch guard)
Ignores events that are not real AI replies (e.g. first_message, command, swipes in progress) or its own quiet generation

evals.name: dice-tool-with-server-log
evals.prompt: Make a SillyTavern extension that lets the model roll dice through function calling (e.g. "2d6+3"), shows the roll result in chat, and also a server plugin that appends every roll to a log file in the current user's data folder. Include both parts and tell me how to install them.
evals.expected_output: UI extension registering a function tool via ToolManager/context with JSON-schema parameters and handling unsupported tool calling; server plugin with info/init/exit, router routes, using request.user.directories, sanitised path, called with getRequestHeaders(); install notes including enableServerPlugins.
assertions: manifest.json is valid JSON with display_name, js and version
No static imports from SillyTavern internal files (uses SillyTavern.getContext() / SillyTavern.libs)
LIVE: loads in SillyTavern 1.19.0 with no extension errors in the console or Manage Extensions
Registers a function tool via registerFunctionTool with a JSON-schema parameters object and an action
Handles tool calling being unavailable (checks isToolCallingSupported or tells the user what to enable)
Server plugin exports info {id, name, description} with an id matching /^[a-z0-9_-]+$/ and init(router)
Server plugin writes under req.user.directories (per-user data folder), validates input and catches errors in async routes
UI extension calls the plugin with getRequestHeaders() (CSRF header) on a non-GET request
Install notes say to set enableServerPlugins: true and restart
LIVE: the server plugin loads in SillyTavern and its log route writes a line for the current user
